rules.reason: a receipt is the operator's own paperwork about their own goods; no delete, because a delivery that arrived cannot be made not to have arrived -- a mistake is a cancelled receipt or an adjustment move, never a vanished row
the lines are the receipt; same scope and the same no-delete posture, and the over-receiving gate in hook_receipt_lines runs on this path whoever the caller is
checking a delivery in is warehouse work, not owner-only work: anybody signed in can book a pallet in, and everything they can put on it is bounded by what the purchase order already committed to

the receiver has to be signed in for the page to know whose warehouse to fold, and the sheet names a supplier and everything we buy from them -- deliberately NOT public, because a page addressed by an internal order id would be an enumeration oracle for the whole purchase ledger; the page itself shows a sign-in prompt rather than an error to anyone who is not
